title: Fast Performance and Charging Mentions
summary: This topic combines unrelated mentions of quick vehicle performance, charging capability or equipment, and other isolated uses of the word fast, with most fragments lacking clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise strong acceleration and performance, with one additional positive fragment mentioning a flexible fast charger without enough detail to summarize the aspect confidently.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention fast charging, charger setup, reversing speed, tire wear, phone charging, and other unrelated uses of fast without a consistently clear evaluative stance.

limitations: The topic cluster mixes several unrelated subjects, including acceleration, EV charging, phone charging, backing speed, tire wear, and an off-topic comparison to another vehicle.
Most fragments are assigned undetermined sentiment, so the evidence for a clear overall customer stance is limited.
One positive charger-related fragment provides too little context to determine whether the praise is for charger function, availability, or another aspect.
